scope: Theorem 7.2 (Matched endpoint densities) of the manuscript “Sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional O(4) model” (preprints/Sharp-mass-bounds-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-model-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87f407df77777ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N ≥ K ≥ 1, and choose any two admitted nearest-neighbor trajectories of these depths with the same terminal coupling h0 ∈ IH. On every common admitted terminal period m, write their exact endpoint densities as ρr(V ) = evrm2 eXr(V ) Ξr(V ), r = N, K, using common compatible label lists. The numbers vr are independent of m. There are constants CH, dH > 0, independent of N, K, h0, m, such that ∥XN − XK∥∞ ≤ CHm2 e−dH K , sup x X ℓ:x∈Pℓ eAsℓ ∥kN,ℓ − kK,ℓ∥∞ ≤ CHe−dH K . (7.5) All the endpoint class bounds hold uniformly. In particular, with t = t0, the canonical part of −Xr is bounded by CLm2(Ht4 + t2) and its error part by m2H−2.05. Every covering support has a connected hull of at most RHsℓ sites. Changing a set B of endpoint spins changes Xr by at most DH|B|. The constants RH, DH can be chosen polynomial in H.
